analysis.headline: USD/KRW retreats to 1,338 on election profit-taking and exporter sales
analysis.summary: USD/KRW eased to around 1,338 (ECB ref 1,338.58) as pre-election profit-taking unwound long-dollar bets and Treasury yields stabilized. While market caution ahead of U.S. election tallies provided an underlying cushion, aggressive dollar sales by semiconductor and auto exporters capped upside, guiding the cross into a lower 1,335–1,343 KRW range.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW rises to 1,508 as euro rebounds on broad dollar pullback
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW rebounded to around 1,508 (ECB ref 1,508.18) as EUR/USD bounced into the mid-1.12s on a broad U.S. dollar pullback. While ongoing Eurozone manufacturing sluggishness and French political concerns lingering in the background capped aggressive gains, solid cross-currency euro demand and KRW resilience supported the pair within a firm 1,504–1,512 KRW range.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW steadies near 845.9 KRW per 100 JPY amid intervention vigilance
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW hovered near 8.46 KRW per 1 JPY (~845.9 KRW per 100 JPY, ECB ref 8.459). Even as the BOJ signaled willingness to hike rates further, USD/JPY held elevated near 158.3, weighing on the yen. However, firm intervention warnings from Japanese authorities established solid support, keeping the cross defended within an 842–849 KRW range.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW advances to 1,807 on dollar softening ahead of BoE meeting
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW strengthened to around 1,807 (ECB ref 1,807.07) as sterling defended 1.348 against the softening dollar ahead of the Bank of England's rate decision. While post-Autumn Budget fiscal scrutiny kept upside in check, firm demand across European crosses and broad USD consolidation supported the cross steadily within a 1,802–1,812 KRW band.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW holds near 200.6 on PBOC liquidity and NPC stimulus hopes
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW traded steadily around 200.6 (ECB ref 200.62) within a 200–202 band. The People's Bank of China maintained accommodative liquidity alongside stable daily benchmark fixings, while anticipation of additional fiscal stimulus from the NPC Standing Committee anchored yuan sentiment. In tandem with USD/KRW easing, the cross moved within an orderly 200.0–201.2 KRW range.

AUD.headline: Australian dollar holds near 939 KRW on hawkish RBA and China stimulus hopes
AUD.brief: The Australian dollar maintained solid defense near 939 KRW, supported by the RBA's hawkish rate hold and optimism surrounding China's NPC fiscal stimulus package.

CAD.headline: Canadian dollar defends 961 KRW with crude support cushioning BoC cuts
CAD.brief: The Canadian dollar held near 961 KRW as resilient crude oil prices and resource exports helped cushion the yield drag from recent Bank of Canada rate cuts.

CHF.headline: Swiss franc strengthens to 1,641 KRW on persistent safe-haven inflows
CHF.brief: The Swiss franc advanced to 1,641 KRW as European political uncertainty and election hedging drove continuous safe-haven demand, outweighing the SNB's low-rate stance.

CNY.headline: Chinese yuan consolidates near 200.6 KRW on PBOC support and stimulus hopes
CNY.brief: The Chinese yuan steadied near 200.6 KRW as PBOC liquidity injections and steady daily fixings complemented anticipation of National People’s Congress fiscal support.

EUR.headline: Euro rebounds to 1,508 KRW as dollar pullback lifts EUR/USD
EUR.brief: The euro rebounded to 1,508 KRW as a broad U.S. dollar pullback pushed EUR/USD into the mid-1.12s, overcoming sluggish Eurozone manufacturing sentiment.

GBP.headline: British pound advances to 1,807 KRW ahead of BoE rate decision
GBP.brief: The British pound climbed to 1,807 KRW, tracking cable’s advance to 1.348 amid dollar weakness while markets awaited the Bank of England’s monetary policy outcome.

HKD.headline: Hong Kong dollar tracks USD easing within peg band to hold 170.6 KRW
HKD.brief: The Hong Kong dollar traded stably near 170.6 KRW within its 7.75–7.85 peg band, closely tracking the U.S. dollar pullback alongside regional equity flows.

JPY.headline: Japanese yen holds near 845.9 KRW per 100 JPY on intervention vigilance
JPY.brief: The Japanese yen defended 845.9 KRW per 100 JPY as Tokyo authorities’ active intervention warnings counterbalanced elevated USD/JPY pressures near 158.

KRW.headline: Korean won rebounds to 1,338 KRW on robust chip exports and 3.00% base rate
KRW.brief: The Korean won gained ground to 1,338 KRW against the dollar, bolstered by steady semiconductor export surpluses and the Bank of Korea’s 3.00% policy rate anchor.

USD.headline: U.S. dollar retreats to 1,338 KRW on pre-election positioning and exporter sales
USD.brief: The U.S. dollar retreated to 1,338 KRW as pre-election profit-taking and heavy corporate dollar sales from tech exporters weighed on greenback momentum.
